description: AI Service Recommendations Endpoint - Add missing POST /recommendations/generate endpoint to complete the evaluation pipeline. Aggregates interview evaluations to produce overall strengths, weaknesses, topics to improve, and feedback. Currently a stub implementation ready for LLM integration later.
steps: Edit ai-service/app/models/schemas.py: add EvaluationSummary(BaseModel) with fields question: str, answer: str, score: int, strengths: List[str], weaknesses: List[str], category: str
Add RecommendationsRequest(BaseModel) with field evaluations: List[EvaluationSummary]
Add RecommendationsResponse(BaseModel) with fields overall_strengths: List[str], overall_weaknesses: List[str], topics_to_improve: List[str], overall_feedback: str
Create ai-service/app/routers/recommendations.py: import FastAPI APIRouter and schemas, create router = APIRouter(prefix='/recommendations', tags=['Recommendations'])
Implement POST /generate endpoint: accept RecommendationsRequest, aggregate unique strengths by flattening all evaluation.strengths and deduping, aggregate unique weaknesses similarly
Compute avg score per category: group evaluations by category, calculate mean score, filter categories where avg < 60 as topics_to_improve

Generate overall_feedback string: f'Based on {len(request.evaluations)} questions, your overall performance was {overall_avg:.1f}%. ' + (f'Focus on improving: {', '.join(topics_to_improve)}.' if topics_to_improve else 'Great job across all areas!')
Edit ai-service/app/main.py: import recommendations router, add app.include_router(recommendations.router) after existing routers
acceptance_criteria: POST /recommendations/generate endpoint responds with 200 and RecommendationsResponse schema
Aggregation logic deduplicates strengths and weaknesses across all evaluations
topics_to_improve identifies categories with average score below 60
overall_feedback is a coherent summary string with score and improvement areas
Router registered in main.py and appears in /docs
verification: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/recommendations/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"evaluations":[{"question":"Test","answer":"Test","score":75,"strengths":["Good"],"weaknesses":["Bad"],"category":"Technical"},{"question":"Test2","answer":"Test2","score":45,"strengths":["Clear"],"weaknesses":["Incomplete"],"category":"Behavioral"}]}' — returns 200 with overall_strengths, overall_weaknesses, topics_to_improve=['Behavioral'], overall_feedback string
